subject: general
question: Who was the first foreign player to complete 5,000 runs in IPL?
solution:
The correct answer is __**David Warner.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **David Warner** was the first foreign player to complete 5,000 runs in IPL.
 
• David Warner is an Australian international cricketer and a former captain of the Australian national team in the limited-overs format and also a former test vice-captain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Suresh Raina was the first-ever batsman to score 5000 runs in the IPL format. 

 
 
• Suresh Raina played for Chennai Super Kings.​
 
 
 
• **Andrew James Tye** is an Australian cricketer who plays One Day Internationals and Twenty20 Internationals for the Australian national cricket team.
 
• **Dale Willem Steyn** is a South African former professional cricketer who played for the South African Cricket Team. 
 
• **Mark Andrew Wood** is an English cricketer who plays internationally for England in all formats.
